## 💡Tips & Tricks

I build these things so that people can learn and take them apart. There is waaaay too much packed in here for just on person to use, and there are nodes here that collect dust, but when I suddenly need them, I'm irritated that they are gone. 

---
## My settings ⚙️
- **I seldom prompt**. I'll run an image through Florence 📝, then let it go through Qwen 📝 and see what it looks like. I'll then cut & paste the final prompt and make edits.
- I use **Beta Sine** and **Gaussian** almost exclusively
- **I never turn sigmas off**. If I get a noisy image, I'll go back to base sigmas. 
- **🤡 Clownsampler**. Basically only when I want cinametic quality images.  
- **Sigma Resample**. It's a cool tweak. I have it sitting on the **high sampler** (structure), so it helps it. I move between **0.8 & 1.25** with an adder of 0 or 2. You can tweak more out of it, but I like set and forget.  
- **Sigma Curve**  I always wanted one since I saw Sam Shark explain [what in the hell is a Sigma?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=egn5dKPdlCk), so I made one. Watch her video so you know just how frigging cool this is. 

---
---

## 💡Tips & Tricks

我把这些东西做成可以拆开学的。这里塞的东西一个人根本用不满，有些节点会吃灰；可真到要用的时候，发现没了会很火大。

---

## 我的设置 ⚙️
- **我很少自己写提示词。** 图先走 Florence 📝，再进 Qwen 📝 看结果，然后把最终提示词剪贴出来改。
- 调度器几乎只用 **Beta Sine** 和 **Gaussian**。
- **Sigma 我从不关。** 图噪了，就退回 Base Sigmas。
- **🤡 Clownsampler** 基本只在想要电影感时才开。
- **Sigma Resample** 是个好用的微调。我把它接在 **high 采样器**（结构段）上。multiplier 在 **0.8～1.25** 之间，adder 用 **0 或 2**。还能再抠，但我喜欢设好就不管。
- **Sigma Curve** 自从看过 Sam Shark 讲 [what in the hell is a Sigma?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=egn5dKPdlCk) 就一直想要一个，所以自己做了。先看她的视频，才知道这有多离谱地好用。

## LC Vision Caption 📝

## ⚠️ Image MUST be on for this to work.
- 🤫 It randomly generates prompts with nothing attached. It's a product of me keeping things running if it has an error, 5% of my images, I just let it go and see what comes out. 

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ This auto downloads the model you choose on the first run, so it will take several minutes.
- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.

**LC Vision Caption 📝**:
- 💡 The node anayzes the image and detects subject, pose, clothing, setting, lighting, color, composition, and mood, not just a one-line summary.
- Each reference gets its own label (`<Reference 1>`, `<Reference 2>`, `<Reference 3>`), described individually instead of mashed into one blob. 😎
- `style_tag` pushes the description toward a specific visual style regardless of what the reference actually looks like.

**💡 Analyzing 3 images at once**
- Custom prompt: "Analyze <Reference 1>, <Reference 2>, and <Reference 3> individually: describe each one's subject, setting, lighting, and mood. Then compare all three and note the key similarities and differences between them."
- The model addresses each picture by its own label instead of blending them together.

---
---

## LC Vision Caption 📝

## ⚠️ 必须打开 Image，这个功能才能工作。
- 🤫 如果什么都没连接，它会随机生成提示词。这是我为了让流程在出错时也能继续运行而留下的副产品。我大约 5% 的图片就是这样来的，我干脆随它去，看看会出来什么。


**LC Vision Loader 🔬**：
- ⚠️ 首次运行时会自动下载你选择的模型，需要几分钟时间。
- 模型选择器会同时显示你已下载的模型，以及可供下载的选项。

**LC Vision Caption 📝**：
- 💡 该节点会分析图像并识别主体、姿势、服装、场景、光线、色彩、构图和氛围，而不只是给出一句话的简单总结。
- 每张参考图都有自己的标签（`<Reference 1>`、`<Reference 2>`、`<Reference 3>`），会被逐一单独描述，而不是混成一团。😎
- `style_tag` 会将描述推向指定的视觉风格，无论参考图实际是什么风格。

**💡 一次分析 3 张图像**
- 自定义提示词："分别分析 <Reference 1>、<Reference 2> 和 <Reference 3>：描述每一张的主体、场景、光线和氛围，然后比较三者，指出它们之间的关键相同点和不同点。"
- 模型会通过各自的标签分别处理每张图片，而不是把它们混在一起。

nodes.title: VOSR2
widgets_values:
## Instructions

## 💡 You can change the order of this by change the setnodes coming in
- to put it before post processing. change the getnode of this to "detail Image", then the Post processing to "VOSR2" image. 
- To put it after, revese the process
- 👋 don't forget to change the final image getnode (above) to match.
- ⚠️ First run downloads the model — about **5 minutes**. Watch the log and wait.

| Input              | Default   | Range                        | Notes |
| ------------------ | --------: | ---------------------------- | ----- |
| `upscale`          | `4`       | ≥ 1, no cap                  | Exact output multiplier |
| `color_alignment`  | `wavelet` | `wavelet` / `adain` / `none` | Post-process vs the bicubic target |
| `tile_size`        | `0`       | `0`–`4096`, step 64          | DiT pixel tile; `0` = no tiling |
| `tile_overlap`     | `32`      | `0`–`512`, step 8            | DiT tile overlap |
| `vae_tile_size`    | `0`       | `0`–`8192`, step 64          | VAE pixel tile; `0` = full-image decode |
| `vae_tile_overlap` | `32`      | `0`–`512`, step 8            | VAE tile overlap |

- **Tiling is not optional above 512 px.** VOSR 2.0 was trained natively up to 512 px. If the *upscaled* output is larger than 512×512, set `tile_size` (e.g. `512`) or quality drops. For outputs well past 1024 px also set `vae_tile_size` (e.g. `1024`) or a full-image VAE decode will likely OOM.

---
---

## 说明

## 💡 想改这段的顺序，改进来的 Set 节点即可
- 要放到后期之前：把这边的 Get 改成 `detail Image`，后期改成 `VOSR2` image。
- 要放到后期之后：反过来改。
- 👋 别忘了把上面最终出图的 Get 也改成同一张。
- ⚠️ 第一次运行大约要 **5 分钟** 下载模型。看着日志等，别急。


| 输入                 |     默认 | 范围                         | 说明 |
| -------------------- | -------: | ---------------------------- | ---- |
| `upscale`            |      `4` | ≥ 1，无上限                  | 精确放大倍数 |
| `color_alignment`    | `wavelet` | `wavelet` / `adain` / `none` | 相对双三次目标做后期对齐 |
| `tile_size`          |      `0` | `0`–`4096`，步进 64          | DiT 像素分块；`0` = 不分块 |
| `tile_overlap`       |     `32` | `0`–`512`，步进 8            | DiT 分块重叠 |
| `vae_tile_size`      |      `0` | `0`–`8192`，步进 64          | VAE 像素分块；`0` = 整图一次解码 |
| `vae_tile_overlap`   |     `32` | `0`–`512`，步进 8            | VAE 分块重叠 |

- **输出超过 512 px 时，分块不是可选项。** VOSR 2.0 原生训练到 512 px。只要**放大后的图**大于 512×512，就把 `tile_size` 设上（例如 `512`），否则画质会掉。输出远超 1024 px 时再设 `vae_tile_size`（例如 `1024`），否则整图 VAE 解码很容易 OOM。

nodes.title: Notes:
widgets_values:
## 🎨 Post Processing

### 🛑🚫✋ I **highly suggest** you fix the seed, run the picture, then do not change anything upstream so it does not reprocess.

**LC Photo Style 📷**
- The camera/phone **finish**: color, tone, texture, vignette, grain.
- Pick a **style** preset, then pull **strength** back if it's too much.
- **skin_protect** keeps **vibrance** from turning skin orange.

**LC Image Adjust**
- Plain hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, sharpness. All 0 = no change.
- 💡 Use it for small fixes after Photo Style.

**LC Apply LUT**
- **strength** 0.2 to 0.4 is usually plenty. Full strength is a sledgehammer.
- Leave **log** off unless the LUT was made for log footage (it will typically say so in the name).
- Get free ones [Here](https://freshluts.com/)
- Drop your `.cube` files here:
```
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    └── luts/
        ├── your_look.cube
        ├── film_emulation.cube
        └── ...
```

**LC Phone Filters 📱**
- It's basically *Instagram* filters.
- 37 phone-app presets (1977, Aden, Brooklyn, etc.).

**LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪**
- Run once so the image shows up on the node, then drag the box and handles.
- **aspect** locks the ratio (free, original, 1:1, 16:9, etc.).

---

## 🎨 后期处理

### 🛑🚫✋ **强烈建议**先固定种子，把图片跑出来，然后不要再改动上游的任何设置，这样就不会重新生成。

**LC Photo Style 📷**
- 相机/手机的**成片风格**：色彩、影调、质感、暗角、颗粒。
- 选择一个 **style** 预设，觉得太重就把 **strength** 调低。
- **skin_protect** 防止 **vibrance** 把皮肤调成橙色。

**LC Image Adjust**
- 基础的色相、饱和度、亮度、对比度、锐度。全部为 0 = 不改变。
- 💡 用它在 Photo Style 之后做小修正。

**LC Apply LUT**
- **strength** 通常 0.2 到 0.4 就足够了。满强度就像拿大锤砸。
- 除非 LUT 是为 log 素材制作的，否则请关闭 **log**（通常文件名里会写明）。
- 免费 LUT 可以在[这里](https://freshluts.com/)下载
- 把 `.cube` 文件放在这里：
```
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    └── luts/
        ├── your_look.cube
        ├── film_emulation.cube
        └── ...
```

**LC Phone Filters 📱**
- 基本上就是 *Instagram* 滤镜。
- 37 个手机应用预设（1977、Aden、Brooklyn 等）。

**LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪**
- 先运行一次，让图片显示在节点上，然后拖动裁剪框和控制点。
- **aspect** 锁定比例（free、original、1:1、16:9 等）。

---

widgets_values:
# Total nodes

**164 nodes** across 6 packs.

| Pack | Nodes |
|---|---|
| LC123 (ComfyUI_LC123_nodes) | 127 |
| LC AV (ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes) | 16 |
| LC MaskMaker (ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes) | 10 |
| LC Vision (ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes) | 4 |
| LC ModelBuilder (ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes) | 4 |
| LC TiledUpscale (ComfyUI_LC_TiledUpscale) | 3 |

---

## LC123 (ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Civitai 🚩🔪** | Strips flagged terms from a prompt using a compliance list, as an aid only (you are still responsible for Civitai's terms). |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Builds separate filename and path outputs for Image Saver style nodes, with optional prefix-in-path and timestamp. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get a separate conditioning and mask for each region, for Anima regional prompting. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed. |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty float. |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | Applies a LORA_STACK from LC LoRA Loader Stack (or any pack) to model and/or clip. |
| **LC Apply LUT** | Applies a .cube 3D LUT from models/luts with a strength from 0 to 2. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | Packs image, mask, size, latent, batch and resolution into an LC_PIPE, or edits one, overwriting only the wired sockets. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | Unpacks the aspect ratio fields of an LC_PIPE into separate sockets and passes the pipe on. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a target size and outputs image, mask, size, empty latent and batch. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Does the same as the Aspect Ratio Simplifier and adds a pipe output for Get/Set. |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | Corrects white balance automatically with a choice of algorithm, a strength blend and a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | Outputs sigmas for the full step count (no denoise), made to feed LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) for dual-pass sampling. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | Batches images from auto-growing slots, ignoring muted or missing ones and resizing later images to the first. |
| **LC Bloom** | Adds a glow from the bright areas, with threshold, radius and intensity controls. |
| **LC Boolean** | Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | Outputs the opposite of its toggle. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION. |
| **LC Bypasser** | Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs (frontend node). |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser (frontend node). |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | Sets camera framing and depth of field for a prompt from distance and angle presets. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | Shifts the RGB channels apart to fake lens fringing, with pixel amount and direction per channel. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | Matches an image's colors to a reference (AdaIN / mean-std) with optional skin protection and mask. |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | Picks a 4 to 6 color palette from a preset or from an image, for use in prompts. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it. |
| **LC Custom Combo** | Builds your own list of options and outputs the chosen text and its index. |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | A remote control that picks the choice for an LC Custom Combo from another spot. |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | Injects latent noise scaled to 1 minus your denoise value, using the same denoise you give the sampler. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | Unpacks the detailer settings (models, prompts, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps) from an LC_PIPE. |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides width and height by one value and rounds the results to integers. |
| **LC Directional Blur** | Motion blur along one angle and length, set by dragging an arrow on the node. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Overlays image B on image A and lets you adjust the opacity on the node after one run without regenerating. |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds a filename_prefix for the native Save Image node and creates the folders. |
| **LC Film Grain** | Adds film grain with amount, contrast, size and mono or color options. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | Gives a black and white film look from presets with a strength blend. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | Gives a color film look from presets (toe, shoulder, gamma) with a strength blend. |
| **LC Float Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two floats. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image's width, height, megapixels, longer side, batch size and aspect ratio. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | Bypasses whole groups from one place, with one toggle per group (frontend node). |
| **LC Image Adjust** | Basic color grade (hue, saturation, brightness, contrast) with a mild sharpen or soften. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Compares large batches of images with a compact dropdown and a stable image area. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | Crops by dragging a box and handles on the node, with an optional aspect lock. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | Smart denoise with blur strength, edge preservation and a blend. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | Desaturates toward grayscale with a factor and a luminance method. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | Arranges a batch of images into a grid with optional gap, outline and border. |
| **LC Image Label** | A floating image sticker with drag-and-drop upload for annotating a workflow (no sockets). |
| **LC Image Pass** | Passes an image straight through, and its enable switch mutes what hangs off it downstream. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | Bundles up to 16 reference images into one pipe, with sockets that grow like Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | Unpacks an image ref pipe back into image_1 to image_16 in their original slots, pipe first. |
| **LC Image RGB** | Offsets each color channel separately with an overall strength. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | A before/after wipe on the node whose output is the baked split for saving. |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | Scales an image to a total megapixel count and outputs the resulting resolution. |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a preset, custom size, multiplier or megapixel count, in multiples of divisible_by. |
| **LC Int Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two integers. |
| **LC Int Split** | Splits a total into a + b at a fractional split point, so a + b always equals the total. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | Coerces a boolean, int or float and outputs the opposite. |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | Joins multiple strings with a delimiter and skips the empty ones. |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get regional conditioning using the krea2 CLIP type. |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | A floating text label for annotating a workflow, with fonts, color, outline and shadow (no sockets). |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | Keeps the last generated image for before/after comparison, even after disconnecting. |
| **LC Lens Effects** | Combines chromatic aberration, vignette and grain in one node. |
| **LC Lens Profile** | Applies or corrects a named lens profile with adjustable strength. |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | Grades shadows, midtones and highlights with lift, gamma, gain and offset. |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Sets lighting style and direction for a prompt from presets plus your own notes. |
| **LC Lighting Control 🔦** | Relights an image from a normal map and a depth map with virtual lights, shadows and an optional subject mask. |
| **LC Lighting Control V2 🔦** | Relights an image with one or two spot or sun lights, warmth, color gels and hard or soft cast shadows. |
